---
title: "Create your personal workspace"
---
> **Workspace template:** TO BE LINKED

1. Create a GitHub account.
2. Open the workspace template repository.
3. Select **Use this template** → **Create a new repository**.
4. Create your repository as **Private**.
5. Open **Code** → **Codespaces** → **Create codespace on main**.
6. Wait for the environment to finish its first initialization.

The first initialization can take a few minutes.
